svg.title: Code architecture — TypeScript frontend, Rust backend, one service layer

g.text: Code architecture — TypeScript frontend, Rust backend, one service layer
The UI only calls generated, typed clients. The same Rust services run in the desktop, the self-host server, AWS Lambda and the CLI.
1 · The UI calls generated, typed clients only, never raw files or databases.
2 · Desktop: Tauri IPC commands, limited by the app's capability set.
3 · Web companion and self-host: HTTP + WebSocket through the generated OpenAPI client.
4 · Managed cloud: the same OpenAPI contract on API Gateway.
5 · Every host calls the same service layer…
8 · …and the CLI, language server and MCP server that publishers, CI, other editors and external agents use.
9 · Every call passes chitkala-policy (grants, consent, budgets) and is audited; all logic lives in the crates.
10 · Rust drives JS-only builds (MDX, Astro) in sandboxed workers and checks their output.
11 · Rust types generate the bindings, OpenAPI and JSON Schemas; CI fails on drift.
